utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: The representative of the Registry, could you please read the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Case Number IT-01-42/1-A, The Prosecutor versus Miodrag Jokic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Thank you. For the appellant, the appearances, please. Counsel for the appellant.

utterances.speaker: MR. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Good afternoon to my colleagues of the Prosecution. My name is Zarko Nikolic, and I'm representing the Defence this afternoon for Admiral Miodrag Jokic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Nikolic. Mr. Jokic, can you understand us?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Yes, I can understand you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Thank you. Appearances for the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. LAMB
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Susan Lamb, and I along with my colleague, Mr. Norman Farrell, and our case manager, Ms. Susan Grogan, appear for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Thank you very much. So the first information I want to give you on behalf of the Bench is that the hearing will take place in the last week of February or beginning of March. Having said this, I would like to know if the appellant, Mr. Nikolic, or Mr. Jokic want to raise anything.

utterances.speaker: MR. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] On behalf of the Defence team, Your Honour, I can say at this point in time, the Defence has nothing to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Nikolic. Mr. Jokic, do you want to raise anything?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, no, I have nothing to raise.

utterances.speaker: MS. LAMB
utterances.text: Your Honour, the Prosecution also has nothing further to raise. We would simply like, however, to thank you for the advance notice of the hearing. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Lamb. So then this Status Conference is adjourned.
